acceptance_note: Runs 1-3 are HMAC-only development-host baselines; runs 4-10 contain actual Groth16 proof bytes; runs 7-10 include cryptographic negative checks; runs 8-9 are 60-second proof-bearing camera soaks; run 10 diagnoses absent raw Annex-B PTS. These are not target-edge measurements or a multi-hour production soak.
benchmark: physical DirectShow camera -> FFmpeg Baseline/CAVLC pipe -> authenticated WebSocket -> native CAVLC patcher
encoder: libx264 ultrafast, Baseline, CAVLC, YUV420P, all-intra keyint=1, qp=22

metric_definitions.active_stream_frame_rate_fps: Decoded frame count divided by wall time from first FFmpeg pipe bytes to camera pipe EOF; arrival throughput, not presentation frame rate.
metric_definitions.capture_process_tree_resources: Test/API root process plus descendants (native CLI and FFmpeg camera encoder) sampled every 100 ms from just before camera launch through stream completion; excludes proof generation and post-capture verification.
metric_definitions.ffprobe_raw_annex_b_rates: Raw Annex-B has no PTS. FFprobe reports avg_frame_rate=25/1 and r_frame_rate near 60, but neither is an observed wall-clock rate; timestamped_frames is 0. The benchmark FPS is independently measured by monotonic pipe arrival timing.
metric_definitions.luma_ssim_mean/min: Per-frame SSIM on decoded luma plane, summarized across all frames.
metric_definitions.native_resources: Native CLI child only; sampled every 100 ms. Excludes API and FFmpeg camera encoder. CPU seconds include process waits.
metric_definitions.segment_process_p50_ms/p95_ms: Native CAVLC process_segment time for IDR segments modified before authenticated payload completion; does not cover pass-through frames or end-to-end frame latency.
metric_definitions.yuv420_psnr_full_video_db: PSNR over all decoded YUV420 samples comparing original encoded Annex-B input with patched Annex-B output.
metric_definitions.yuv420_psnr_min_modified_frame_db: Minimum PSNR among non-identical decoded frames.

proof_contract: Runs 1-3 are the earlier HMAC-authenticated application-bytes baseline and contain no Groth16 proof. Runs 4-10 include an actual 129-byte Groth16 proof generated for the message and key, blind-extracted, decompressed and verified after the stream.

runs.payload_contract: 4-byte message length + message + 129-byte Groth16 proof; this whole blob is wrapped by the native HMAC frame
